description: Read a saved result by result_id and pull only what you need. A result is saved when you call a data tool with _handle:true (needs an account and a retention setting, see result_settings). fields: dot paths to keep ("name", "address.city"). rows: how many rows (25), a range ("10-34"), or {"offset":0,"limit":25}. filter: keep rows matching every condition, e.g. {"state":"CA","amount":{"gt":1000}} (operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, in, exists, startswith). With no arguments you get th

fields.description: Dot paths to keep. With rows/filter they project each row; otherwise they project the result itself.

filter.description: Conditions on row fields, all must match. Value = equality; or {"gt":1000}, {"contains":"acme"}, {"in":["CA","NY"]}, {"exists":true}.

max_chars.description: Cap on the reply size, default 60000, max 400000.

result_id.description: The result_id a handle-mode call returned (r?_ followed by 20 characters).

rows.description: Row count (25), range ("10-34"), or {"offset":0,"limit":25}. Applies to the array of rows in the result.

rows_path.description: Dot path to the array of rows when the result has several (the summary names the one detected).

name: npi-registry__result_get
